{{Quote|I would like to see the corsair that could punch a hole in her.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]] on the ''Karbarr's Fortress''|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
'''''Karbarr's Fortress''''' was a modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] which was for sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] used space [[Transport/Legends|transport]] salesman [[Fiz Cor'gril]].<ref name="AJ9" />

==Characteristics==
Karbarr's Fortress boasted additional armor plating over the standard [[Trimantium/Legends|trimantium]] hull and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] as well as upgraded [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Boav Ion Drive]]s to compensate for the added weight.<ref name="AJ9" />

One of this ship's original pulse [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] was removed to facilitate the shield upgrades, resulting in faulty wiring of the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] to the [[Power core/Legends|power core]]. The ship often lost power when the shields were under duress.<ref name="AJ9" />

The ship's cargo distribution was left like in the original model, with two separate cargo holds capable to support different environmental condiitons. The total cargo capacity was 800 metric tons.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
The ''Karbarr's Fortress'' was put on sale at ''[[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]]'' for 170,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="AJ9" />
